title: Travel: John Lennon – Los Angeles to Yokohama | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono set sail from Los Angeles to Yokohama in Japan on 30 December 1970.

They had arrived in LA the previous day. Lennon’s US visa was due to expire at the end of the year, so he and Ono boarded the SS President Cleveland to Yokohama. The steam liner was bound for Honolulu, calling en route in Japan.

Lennon and Ono arrived in Yokohama Port on 13 January 1971, and travelled that day to the Tokyo Hilton hotel.
